hypothesis.statement: No candidate was implemented or tested in this session. Ranked candidates H-N1 (metric-aware sparse placement, in-lane), H-N3 (heat-flow corridor, out of lane), H-N5 (electrical conductance, largely redundant with official stack), and H-N4 (slip/dilation tendency, label-leakage trap) are proposals only; see docs/session-20261009-review.md section 3.

mechanism: Not tested. The official distance-weighted Tversky metric is recall-dominant (beta 0.8 > alpha 0.2) with linear kernel credit k(d)=max(1-d/3,0) per truth pixel; a dot at distance d scores k(d) against an isolated truth pixel (synthetic check D3).
non_fault_mimic: Lithologic contacts and dikes: elongated and strike-coherent; the tensor lane cannot separate them from faults by geometry alone.
Compact intrusions, volcanic centres, and hydrothermal systems: produce strong ridges without 2-D structure.
Survey-line striping and tie-line or levelling residuals: one-dimensional by construction; must be masked.
Acquisition seams and FFT padding artefacts: linear responses at block edges.
